APP.TITLE: PilateSafe
APP.DISCLAIMER: IMPORTANT: This is general educational information only and is NOT a substitute for professional medical advice. Consult the client's doctor or a qualified physical therapist before starting, modifying, or continuing any Pilates practice, especially with health conditions. Stop immediately if the client feels pain.
